hero.description: Turn your favourite place in Norway into a 3D landscape, framed and ready for display.

theScape.title: From Map To Frame.
theScape.description: With just a few clicks you can transform any Norwegian landscape into a stunning 3D topographic model. Our service captures elevation data and terrain contours to create precision-crafted artwork that celebrates the beauty of your favorite places.

p1.title: Millimeter-Accurate Relief
p1.description: Every model is derived from geographic elevation data, translating real-world terrain into a detailed physical relief.

p2.title: Sculpted for Natural Light
p2.description: A refined matte finish brings out the contours of the terrain, with subtle shadows that shift as natural light moves through the room.

p3.title: Finished to Fit Your Space
p3.description: Each piece is presented in a carefully selected frame, with oak, walnut, black and white finishes and your choice of passe-partout.

showcase.title: How it works.
showcase.description: Explore our interactive map interface to select your coordinates, adjust vertical relief scaling, and preview the 3D model in real time.

specs.title: Designed for scandinavian interiors.
specs.description: Every SCAPE is made to order using high-resolution data and our proprietary modeling algorithm, ensuring clean edges and a tactile texture that brings every landscape to life.

madeToOrder.title: Made to order
madeToOrder.desc: Each piece is produced individually for your order.

madeInBergen.title: Made in Bergen
madeInBergen.desc: Designed and produced in Bergen, Norway, with delivery throughout Norway.

finish.title: A considered finish
finish.desc: Assembled as a complete piece of wall art, ready to find its place in your home.

cta.title: Try it out.
cta.description: Choose any coordinate across Norway. Preview the 3D model in real time, choose your framing, and receive a bespoke art piece.
